name: Muscle Mutt / pitched-yellow-for-two
notes: Muscle Mutt is Generic, yellow pitch2, printed cost3, power6, defense2, and has no functional text/keywords. Both young Dorintheas legally use Generic cards; their weapon-hit ability never applies to these attack action cards. Start with1 floating resource; play Generic Raging Onslaught red costing3, and pitch Muscle Mutt yellow for exactly2. Resource total3 pays cost3; if Muscle Mutt pitched1 the source would remain unpaid, and if it pitched3 one resource would remain. The primary is pitched, not played.
